response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates extensive software development experience across diverse domains, they lack critical required qualifications for this embedded networking security role. Most significantly, there is no evidence of native Japanese language proficiency (explicitly required), and the career trajectory shows primarily TypeScript/Node.js web development rather than strong C programming expertise. The resume contains no demonstrated knowledge of security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption), embedded networking protocols (Layer-2/3, SNMP, NETCONF), or firmware development—all core to this position.
strengths: 16+ years of software development experience across diverse domains and multiple programming languages
Strong DevOps and infrastructure expertise including CI/CD, Docker, and development environment setup
General Linux experience and demonstrated ability to work across different technology stacks
concerns: Missing native-level Japanese language proficiency, which is explicitly listed as a required qualification
Minimal C programming background; recent career heavily focused on TypeScript/Node.js web development rather than C for embedded systems
No demonstrated expertise in security technologies, embedded networking protocols, or firmware development—core focus areas of the role

key_factors.factor: Limited C programming expertise vs. strong requirement
